scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial identities are verified with reproducible standalone Python scripts, and existing normal-form/automorphism-group theorems are credited. No independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Specific to characteristic eleven; only geometric p-rank and a-number, not Newton polygons or full Ekedahl--Oort strata; isomorphism classification uses the published all-parameter isomorphism theorem; older equivalent calculations may exist.
title: Forty-five rank-zero parameters and seven quaternionic isomorphism classes in characteristic eleven
